notes: It correctly makes structural checks quote-aware across the parser, but leaves the quoted-token exception out of the address suffix check, so a quoted address ending in `{` is still rejected.

This comprehensively makes structural brace checks quote-aware throughout the dispenser and parser and adds strong coverage for quoted and nested braces.
Comprehensively treats only unquoted braces as structural across the dispenser and parser, with strong regression coverage; only minor documentation and helper-centralization gaps remain.
The core fix is comprehensive and well tested, but the extra import-token quote propagation is broader than necessary and reuses mutated quote state across variadic replacements.
The core parsing fix is broad and tested, but the extra import quote propagation is complex, changes behavior beyond the reference, and incorrectly carries quoted state between variadic arguments.
Fixes the literal-key reproduction, but still discards dynamic import blocks and conflates distinct keyed module instances, while adding unnecessary configuration and graph refactoring.
